# Oasis Baklawa

Oasis Baklawa is a family-owned Indian business that began by bringing baklava from a Dubai
patisserie to the Indian market, and later expanded into local manufacturing and a wider range
of baklava, artisanal chocolates, confections and specialty gifts. The production facility is in
Kirti Nagar, New Delhi. The brand is owned by TCF Chocolates & Gifts Pvt. Ltd.

## Categories
- Premium Baklawa
- Arabic Dates (Fresh Dates, Tamaar Khaleeji, Tomoor, Chocodates)
- Chocolates (ganache, pralines, brittles and dragees)
- Fusion Sweets (balls and bites)
- Turkish Delight
- Nuts & Mixes (dry fruits, trail mixes, dragees)
- Luxury Gifting
- Corporate Gifting
- Festival Gifting
- Wedding Gifting
- Dessert Catering

## Gifting occasions
- Corporate gifting for clients, teams and partners
- Wedding gifting, trousseau and guest favours
- Festival gifting for Diwali, Eid, Holi, Raksha Bandhan, Christmas and Navratri
- Baby shower, naming and annaprashan gifting
- Personal occasions: birthdays, anniversaries, housewarming, thank-you
- Premium gifting: milestones and diplomatic gifting
